rather than just working the queue Incident Response Be the first point of contact for platform incidents during your working hours Manage the public status page and customer communication during incidents Coordinate with engineering on diagnosis and resolution, and follow up with clear updates until it is closed What You Bring Strong TypeScript and React background Solid modern web app fundamentals including HTTP, APIs, authentication, and databases Proven ability to debug production issues using logs, traces, repros, and minimal test cases Strong systems and architecture thinking, LLM-based applications Experience building automations or internal tooling to scale a support function Experience managing platform incidents and public status communication Experience supporting Route requests for new version support to ELS engineering with a clear statement; do not promise dates. Debug the KernelCare agent and ePortal on the customer side, missing patches, new kernel and distro support requests. Own our Zendesk: queues, triggers, macros, SLA policies, bots and the Jira and Slack bridges. You take this over from the CloudLinux Zendesk admin in your first weeks and run it after. Build and run the AI triage agent and support tools: Zendesk, Jira and Slack integrations, log and data checks (Python, REST APIs, LLM APIs). Maintain support and release scripts together with the dev teams. Lead the support side during big CVE events, when many customers ask at once. Experience with Gerrit, CI pipelines, and package signing. What's in it for you? A focus on professional development. Interesting and challenging projects.
